description: This file defines classes and functions related to tensor reduction operations in PyTorch's JIT tensor expression framework, including Reducer, ReduceOp, and specific reducers like Sum, Max, and Min.

classes.name: Reducer
classes.description: Class representing a reduction operation with initialization, interaction, and methods to generate reduction expressions.

classes.name: ReduceOp
classes.description: Class representing a reduction operation node in the expression graph, including its body, reduction variables, buffers, and reducer.

classes.name: Sum
classes.description: A specific Reducer implementation for summation.

classes.name: Maximum
classes.description: A Reducer for maximum value reduction.

classes.name: Minimum
classes.description: A Reducer for minimum value reduction.

classes.name: ReductionExpander
classes.description: IRMutator subclass for expanding reduction expressions.

methods.name: initializer
methods.description: Returns the initial value for the reduction.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Methods to generate reduction expressions with different parameters.

methods.name: getReduceBody
methods.description: Static methods to generate the body of a reduction based on different function signatures.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Static methods to finalize a reduction expression by applying the interaction function.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Static factory methods to create ReduceOp expressions.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the body expression to obtain the value to be reduced.

methods.name: reduce_args
methods.description: Returns the variables associated with the axes of reduction.
